title: Design a Sprint Dashboard Frontend
reported: Frontend system design: a dynamic sprint dashboard with configurable columns (Backlog, In Progress, ...) using reusable, versioned UI components.

sources.passage:
Jira tickets, user stories, Confluence documents, and BitBucket code reviews can be tagged with `#project-xyz` for easier tracking.

**Functional requirements**:
1. **Fetches all tagged entities**: The system should efficiently retrieve all entities owned by a customer that are tagged with a specific hashtag, across multiple products.
2. **Top 10 Hashtags**: Design a solution to identify the top 10 hashtags globally (across all customers) with the most tagged entities. Similar to "Top-K leader board problem"

**Non-functional requirements:**
1. The system should be highly configurable to allow new product types and entity types to be added.
2. Hashtags are dynamic, with no pre-defined set, meaning users can create any tag.

The focus was on schema design and choosing the right database and mapping structure for efficient querying.

#### _For Frontend Roles:_
A friend shared insights from the frontend system design round. The task was to design a dynamic sprint dashboard where users could modify the dashboard by adding columns such as “Backlog,” “Scheduled,” “In Progress,” etc. Each column could contain entities like tasks or stories.

The key areas of focus were:
- **Reusable UI Components**: The UI components, such as tasks or stories, should be reusable. For example, a Task should be rendered using the same UI component each time.
- **Versioning**: Instead of modifying existing UI components, the idea of creating a new version of the component, similar to versioning in backend systems (e.g., Maven), was emphasized.

reported: SRE craft round with a senior architect: given a system architecture, discuss (1) monitoring parameters and golden signals, (2) troubleshooting steps for an incident scenario, and (3) reliability measures to keep availability at 99.99%.

sources.passage:
Atlassian | Infrastructure Engineer | Interview Experience |
In continuation to my initial round experience mentioned [here](https://leetcode.com/discuss/post/7495920/atlassian-interview-experience-p40-5-yoe-4epp/), below is the experience for further round

In the mid june, I got callback from recruiter for further process, since the role was not pure backend role but a mix one, so they need an additional round for this.

**Round 7: SRE Craft (1 Hour)**
It was scheduled with a Senior Architect which was divided into 3 parts, where given a design architecture of a system and have answer various questions. Each part was 15-20 mins each where
- First part was related to monitoring parameters and golden signals. 
- Second part related to trounbleshooting steps for an incident scenario
- Third part related to reliability paraters to keep the system availability to 99.99%

**After a week, I got the update that feedback was positive and can move with offer letter. And on 1st july I received final offer.**

Compensation was not any extraordinary, similar to details already present publicly on LC discussion and levels fyi website. It all depends on previous compensation as well

* The fourth question was a 2 pointer Approach:https://leetcode.com/discuss/interview-question/892579/paint-the-ceiling-swe-hackerrank-test

Anyone who solved 3.5-4 questions was shortlisted for the next round. Out of 400 people 8 were shortlisted for Interview and I was fortunate enough to be one amongst the eight.

Our Interview was scheduled on 1st of September,2022. I had the interview early morning from 8:30-9:30 PM.

* The first was a Coding Interview round in which the interviewer gave me a question to design a RATE-LIMITER. In that question the interviewer gave me a vector of pair (customerId, time(in milliseconds) in which he ping),we have to return a vector of bool values as answer if the given pair is valid or not . A unique user can ping at most twice in a 1-second duration. I was able to solve the question in 0(n) Time and o(n) space. the interviewer was ok with the approach as well as code. After that round 6/8 were given the chance for managerial round and I was one of them.
* The second round began at 10 am till 10:45 am,the interviewer was an engineering project manager,he deep dived into my group project about file tagging system. The interview lasted about 40-45 minutes.

The results were declared that very evening 5/6 were the final selects and I was one of them.
